evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!37 and Internal Quality Checks!37 require judge-created distinctive values to be absent from seed and reference initial state. The only fixed mutation literal in the actual criteria is MULTI in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic); other source, title, filename, error, find, replace and marker probes are chosen by the judge or required to be fresh/unique. A literal rg -l -F MULTI over task/solution/app/src, task/solution/app/public, task/solution/app/static and task/environment/assets returned no files. The seed at environment/assets/seed_data.json has snippets: [], and app.tsx:21-27 initializes code to empty and snippets to []; app.tsx:93 supplies only a Hello, Colderwater/Ready to explore new-draft example, with no MULTI or saved identity. server.js:147-168 creates tables and copies only pre-existing snippets into history; it does not insert a probe. A broken app that merely exposes this initial example or static empty library cannot satisfy MULTI appearing once at each of three judge-created carets, nor a unique saved title/filename/source read back from an independent context. A conforming implementation starting with an empty library can satisfy both after browser actions. No raw-evidence-index.json existed at review time; this verdict is the source-level pre-satisfaction check, not a full configured judge or portal result.
